The CLI in radon/cli/__init__.py:160 resolves the order option with getattr(cc_mod, order.upper(), getattr(cc_mod, 'SCORE')). Unknown values therefore fall back to SCORE silently. Review points: (1) ALPHA sorts on block.name, so it is case-sensitive and may mis-order mixed-case names; (2) SCORE negates the complexity, which gives a descending order but leaves ties unordered beyond sort stability; (3) radon/raw.py and radon/metrics.py consume or report block-level measurements, so I would check that their output is consistent with the ordering keys, such as lineno and name attributes being present on the objects they produce; (4) radon/visitors.py defines the block objects that carry lineno and name, so a brief check of those attributes is enough.
